title: incident-bot: add on-call escalation telemetry and SLO toolkit hooks
author: Priya Nambiar
description: Adds structured telemetry for on-call escalation events and light-weight hooks in the SLO toolkit to consume those events. Motivation: during recent incidents we lacked a clear signal for escalation lifecycle (start, acknowledgment, handoff, resolution) that ties to SLO impact. This PR emits normalized events from incident-bot and wires a new set of listeners in slo-toolkit to tag SLO windows and generate contextual alerts. The change is backward-compatible: all emitted events default to no-op behavior unless a consumer registers a handler. Includes unit and integration tests, Helm value additions for optional telemetry sinks, and docs updates for oncall runbooks. Related Linear: ENG-4231 (escalation telemetry), ENG-4250 (slo-toolkit hooks); Support ticket SUP-1098 provided incident traces motivating this work.

feat: slo-toolkit listeners and public hooks for escalation events

docs: update oncall runbooks and developer guide

review_comments: Ethan Park: Please add a short TTL on buffered events to avoid memory growth if a consumer is down.
Priya Nambiar: Good catch - added TTL with a default of 5m and a helm value to tune it.
Marta Ruiz: Can we make the emitted event schema stable (version field) so consumers can evolve?
Priya Nambiar: Added "schema_version" to events and documented in escalation-telemetry.md
Samir Gupta: Integration tests flaked once in CI (timeout) - can we increase the retry or extend the test timeout?
Priya Nambiar: Increased retry and extended timeout; re-ran the integration suite, all green.
release_notes: Emit structured escalation telemetry from incident-bot and expose slo-toolkit hooks so on-call teams can correlate escalations with SLO windows. Controlled by a feature flag and opt-in Helm values. Backward-compatible.
